    <h1>Kabir Lab</h1>
    <p class="lead-copy">We combine quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, QM/MM, and automated workflows to study how molecular environments control light, reactivity, and recognition.</p>

<section class="band alt">
  <p class="section-kicker">Research identity</p>
  <h2>Molecular behavior is shaped by environment.</h2>
  <p class="lead-copy">Our work asks how electrostatics, hydrogen bonding, solvation, conformational sampling, and molecular architecture reshape excited states and intermolecular interactions. We develop reproducible computational workflows and apply them to flavins and fluorescent proteins, photoactive molecules, molecular association, and functional ionic materials.</p>
</section>

<section class="band">
  <p class="section-kicker">Research pillars</p>
  <h2>Three evidence-backed directions</h2>
  <div class="grid-3">
    <article class="card pillar-card">
      <div class="pillar-visual" role="img" aria-label="Stylized excited-state map with field contours and chromophore-like nodes."></div>
      <div>
        <span class="mini-label">Photophysics</span>
        <h3>Molecular photophysics in complex environments</h3>
        <p>How do local electrostatics, hydrogen bonding, redox and protonation state, protein structure, and molecular architecture control absorption, fluorescence, intersystem crossing, and charge-transfer pathways?</p>
        <a href="research/photophysics.html">Read about photophysics</a>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="card pillar-card">
      <div class="pillar-visual" role="img" aria-label="Stylized multiscale simulation workflow with linked boxes and molecular traces."></div>
      <div>
        <span class="mini-label">Workflows</span>
        <h3>Multiscale simulation and reliable workflows</h3>
        <p>How can electronic structure, molecular dynamics, QM/MM, conformational sampling, explicit solvent, and analysis become reproducible enough for systematic comparison?</p>
        <a href="research/multiscale-workflows.html">Read about workflows</a>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="card pillar-card">
      <div class="pillar-visual" role="img" aria-label="Stylized interaction map with surface regions and association pathways."></div>
      <div>
        <span class="mini-label">Interactions</span>
        <h3>Interaction mapping and functional molecular design</h3>
        <p>Where do molecules preferentially interact, how strong are those associations in a given environment, and how can that information guide molecular or materials design?</p>
        <a href="research/interactions-materials.html">Read about interactions</a>
      </div>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band dark">

  <h2>Representative outputs</h2>

      <h3>Stimulus-driven multipathway emission in 9-fluorenone derivatives</h3>
      <p class="pub-meta">ACS Applied Energy Materials</p>
      <p>Explains how molecular structure and environment redistribute fluorescence, charge-transfer emission, phosphorescence, and delayed fluorescence pathways.</p>
      <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acsaem.5c00577">DOI</a>
    </article>
    <article class="publication-card">
      <span class="mini-label">2024</span>
      <h3>Electronic-structure methods for flavin spectroscopy and photophysics</h3>
      <p class="pub-meta">The Journal of Physical Chemistry B</p>
      <p>Benchmarks multiple electronic-structure methods for flavin excited states and spectroscopic properties.</p>
      <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c03748">DOI</a>
    </article>
    <article class="publication-card">
      <span class="mini-label">2023</span>
      <h3>Alternative strategy for spectral tuning of flavin-binding fluorescent proteins</h3>
      <p class="pub-meta">The Journal of Physical Chemistry B</p>
      <p>Combines maps, simulations, QM/MM calculations, mutagenesis, and spectroscopy to test rational color tuning.</p>
      <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcb.2c06475">DOI</a>

    <article class="software-card">
      <h3>Electrostatic Spectral Tuning Maps</h3>
      <p>Protocol for mapping how electrostatic environments tune molecular spectral features.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/Electrostatic-Spectral-Tuning-Maps">Repository</a>
    </article>
    <article class="software-card">
      <h3>QM/MM Protocol for Flavoproteins</h3>
      <p>Research workflow for APEC-style QM/MM modeling of flavoprotein environments.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/QM-MM-Protocol-for-Flavoproteins">Repository</a>
    </article>
    <article class="software-card">
      <h3>AutoSolvate contribution</h3>
      <p>Fork of a Liu Group project for explicit-solvent quantum chemistry setup, shown here as a related contribution rather than a sole Kabir Lab product.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/AutoSolvate">Repository</a>
